title.narrative: EU4Health - Contribution to the availability and access to vaccines against COVID-19 in Bosnia and Herzegovina

description.narrative: Overall ObjectiveTo mitigate the social and economic impact of COVID-19 in Bosnia and Herzegovina. A country scores higher HDI when the lifespan is higher, the education level is higher, and the GDP per capita is higher.

title.narrative: Vaccinated healthcare workers

description.narrative: Vaccinated: Healthcare workersPersons over 65 years old in social longterm residential care institutions and their staffPersons with chronic diseases and older than 60 years (depending on the pace of vaccine delivery, the priority is older age groups). Above mentioned populations groups were vaccinated in accordance with the TESSY report that started to be fulfilled by the end of June 2021. There were not any other ways of reporting up to the mentioned date. TESSY report includes details about vaccinated that is performed through all mechanisms (EU4Health, COVAX donation and direct procurement). It has been several times mentioned that system of reporting at this moment does not recognize vaccination process by each of four procurement mechanisms.
